evidence.R1-07: Appendix A CO-A3 row: refund is created 'on its first call that returns a refund; every later call returns that same refund (SG-01)', so a second ProviderUnavailable means no refund exists and 'the refund has not been issued' is true; the history the finding says merges unknown effects cannot occur.
evidence.R1-09: CO-S11 Unambiguity note settles it: 'in row 2 the agent learns the order shipped only from a lookup after the unanswered cancellation', so the lookup after the timeout shows shipped and no second CO-A2 is due.
evidence.R1-14: G-04 is a necessary condition ('repeats it only when'), not a permission; CO-06 ('a second CO-A2 only after ... a lookup made after it shows the order still placed or processing') and the CO-A2 failure row ('Make no CO-A2 or CO-A3 until a lookup made after it answers') add the lookup requirement without conflict, so CO-S13's verdict is settled.
evidence.R1-15: CO-07 'tells the customer store staff will follow up once the order system has created the task' lets the 'once' clause attach to 'will follow up' (content) or 'tells' (timing); §5.2 'A rubric judge reads every text the agent sends, including text sent alongside a tool call' plus CO-S23's 'never says ... that staff will follow up' fails an agent built to the content reading, and no rule fixes the timing.
evidence.R2-01: G-03 requires it: 'Otherwise it tells the customer the action was not done or, when it cannot tell, that the outcome is unknown'; both CO-A2 failure rows cite G-03 and no CO-A3 was made, so the dimension's 'no refund was issued' follows from a rule.
evidence.R2-03: G-01 limits the agent to 'at most the one order the current request is about' with every other order 'unchanged at its end' of the conversation, but no rule or failure row says what the agent tells a customer who asks to cancel two orders, and no scenario holds back on such a request (packet Q4 case 1 makes two open orders a known situation).
evidence.R2-04: Same defect as R1-15, still present on the unchanged CO-07 line: 'tells the customer store staff will follow up once the order system has created the task' does not say whether the message may be sent before or alongside the CO-A4, and CO-S23's 'never says ... that staff will follow up' rubric reads text sent alongside tool calls (§5.2).
evidence.R2-06: The failure row for an unanswered first CO-A3 requires the retry with no condition ('Make CO-A3 once more, relying on SG-01'), and the input says the same (packet Q4 case 3: 'agent retries once, then re-reads'), so a run that skips the retry is not a valid variation and 'exactly twice' is correct.
evidence.R2-07: Packet tool confirmation change 4: 'Reads may be retried on timeout without limit; only commit calls are bounded'; in CO-S10/S14/S15/S21 every lookup times out, so 1 or 20 retries before the handoff both pass by design and no verdict depends on the count.
evidence.R3-04: Same line as R1-09, and the CO-S11 Unambiguity note is still there in the final spec: 'in row 2 the agent learns the order shipped only from a lookup after the unanswered cancellation', which fixes the post-timeout status as shipped.
evidence.R3-05: Same as R1-14: G-04's 'only when' clauses restrict retries and do not authorize them; CO-06 and the CO-A2 failure row ('Make no CO-A2 or CO-A3 until a lookup made after it answers') require the lookup, so no reading of G-04 permits a blind cancel retry.
evidence.R3-06: Same as R2-06: the CO-A3 failure row 'Make CO-A3 once more, relying on SG-01' and packet case 3 'agent retries once, then re-reads the order and refund records' require the second CO-A3 whatever an extra lookup shows.
